notes.title: Ex Angelus Demo is Officially Released!!!
notes.notes:
[b]The Ex Angelus Demo is officially out!
[/b]
Hello everyone! It's my pleasure to finally have content for all of you to try out. This Demo covers the introduction to [b]Ex Angelu[/b]s plot and allows you to experience the major gameplay loop. Feedback can be sent in the game's title screen, and is greatly appreciated. I want to know how you felt about your experience!

I am Fluffy the Kami, the sole developer of Kami no Kami Shrine. Ex Angelus is my first major game, and I can't wait to continue this journey with you all.
